verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְחָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠גָלוּתֵנוּ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ הַשָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכְּתָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר בְּעֶ֣צֶם׀ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלַי֙ יַד־ יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš šā·nāh lə·ḡā·lū·ṯê·nū bə·rōš haš·šā·nāh be·‘ā·śō·wr la·ḥō·ḏeš bə·’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ’a·ḥar ’ă·šer huk·kə·ṯāh hā·‘îr bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh hā·yə·ṯāh ‘ā·lay yaḏ- Yah·weh way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî šām·māh
verses.literal: In the twenty-fifth . . . year of our exile at the beginning of the year on the tenth day of the month in the fourteenth . . . year after Jerusalem had been struck down on that very day the hand of the LORD was upon me and He took me there
verses.literalPt: No ano vinte e cinco do nosso cativeiro, no princípio do ano, no décimo dia do mês, no ano quatorze depois que a cidade foi ferida, nesse mesmo dia, veio sobre mim a mão de Jeová, e ele me levou para lá.

verses.original: בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֔ים הֱבִיאַ֖נִי אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְנִיחֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הַ֤ר גָּבֹ֙הַּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְעָלָ֥יו כְּמִבְנֵה־ עִ֖יר מִנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mar·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hĕ·ḇî·’a·nî ’el- ’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl way·nî·ḥê·nî ’el- har gā·ḇō·ah mə·’ōḏ wə·‘ā·lāw kə·miḇ·nêh- ‘îr min·ne·ḡeḇ
verses.literal: In visions of God He took me to the land of Israel and set me on a very . . . high mountain on whose southern slope was a structure that resembled a city
verses.literalPt: Em visões de Deus, me levou à terra de Israel e me pôs sobre um monte mui alto, sobre o qual estava um como edifício de cidade para a banda do sul.

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨יא אוֹתִ֜י שָׁ֗מָּה וְהִנֵּה־ אִישׁ֙ מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וּפְתִיל־ פִּשְׁתִּ֥ים בְּיָד֖וֹ וּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה וְה֥וּא עֹמֵ֖ד בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇê ’ō·w·ṯî šām·māh wə·hin·nêh- ’îš mar·’ê·hū kə·mar·’êh nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·p̄ə·ṯîl- piš·tîm bə·yā·ḏōw ū·qə·nêh ham·mid·dāh wə·hū ‘ō·mêḏ baš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: So He took me there and I saw a man whose appearance . . . was like bronze He was standing in the gateway with a linen cord and a measuring rod in his hand
verses.literalPt: Ele me levou para lá, e eis um homem cujo parecer era como o parecer de cobre. Ele tinha na mão um cordel de linho e uma cana de medir e estava de pé na porta.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜י הָאִ֗ישׁ בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶיךָ֩ וּבְאָזְנֶ֨יךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְשִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֗ לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לְמַ֥עַן הַרְאוֹתְכָ֖ה הֻבָ֣אתָה הֵ֑נָּה הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lay hā·’îš ben- ’ā·ḏām rə·’êh ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā šə·mā‘ wə·śîm lib·bə·ḵā lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî mar·’eh ’ō·w·ṯāḵ kî lə·ma·‘an har·’ō·wṯ·ḵāh hu·ḇā·ṯāh hên·nāh hag·gêḏ ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh rō·’eh lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Son of man he said to me . . . look with your eyes hear with your ears and pay attention . . . to everything I am going to show you for that is why you have been brought here Report to the house of Israel everything you see
verses.literalPt: Disse-me o homem: Filho do homem, vê com os teus olhos, e ouve com os teus ouvidos, e aplica o teu coração a tudo quanto eu te hei de mostrar, pois, para eu to mostrar, foste para aqui trazido. Anuncia à casa de Israel tudo quanto estás vendo.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִח֥וּץ לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וּבְיַ֨ד הָאִ֜ישׁ קְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֤וֹת בָּֽאַמָּה֙ וָטֹ֔פַח וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ רֹ֤חַב הַבִּנְיָן֙ קָנֶ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וְקוֹמָ֖ה קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḥō·w·māh mi·ḥūṣ lab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ ū·ḇə·yaḏ hā·’îš qə·nêh ham·mid·dāh šêš- ’am·mō·wṯ bā·’am·māh wā·ṭō·p̄aḥ way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- rō·ḥaḇ hab·bin·yān qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ wə·qō·w·māh qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: And I saw a wall surrounding . . . the temple area Now the length of the measuring rod in the man’s hand was six long cubits each measuring a cubit and a handbreadth and he measured the wall to be one rod thick and one rod high
verses.literalPt: Eis um muro ao redor da casa do lado de fora, e, na mão do homem, uma cana de medir de seis cúbitos de comprimento, tendo cada cúbito um cúbito e um palmo. Ele mediu a largura do edifício: era uma cana; e a altura: uma cana.

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־ שַׁ֙עַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֔ימָה וַיַּ֖עַל בְּמַעֲלוֹתוֹ וַיָּ֣מָד׀ אֶת־ סַ֣ף הַשַּׁ֗עַר קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֵת֙ סַ֣ף אֶחָ֔ד קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד רֹֽחַב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’el- ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pā·nāw de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏî·māh way·ya·‘al bə·ma·ʿă·lō·ṯō way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- sap̄ haš·ša·‘ar qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ rō·ḥaḇ wə·’êṯ sap̄ ’e·ḥāḏ qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ rō·ḥaḇ
verses.literal: Then he came to the gate facing . . . east and climbed its steps He measured the threshold of the gate to be one rod deep - . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, veio à porta que olha para o oriente e subiu pelos seus degraus; mediu o limiar da porta: era uma cana de largo; e o outro limiar: uma cana de largo.

verses.original: וְהַתָּ֗א קָנֶ֨ה אֶחָ֥ד אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ וְקָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וּבֵ֥ין הַתָּאִ֖ים חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְסַ֣ף הַ֠שַּׁעַר מֵאֵ֨צֶל אוּלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵֽהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hat·tā qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ ’ō·reḵ wə·qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ rō·ḥaḇ ū·ḇên hat·tā·’îm ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ wə·sap̄ haš·ša·‘ar mê·’ê·ṣel ’ū·lām haš·ša·‘ar mê·hab·ba·yiṯ qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Each gate chamber was one rod long and one rod . . . wide and there were five cubits between the gate chambers The inner threshold of the gate by the portico . . . facing inward was one rod deep
verses.literalPt: Cada câmara tinha uma cana de comprido e uma cana de largo; o espaço entre as câmaras era de cinco cúbitos, e o limiar da porta junto ao vestíbulo da porta, para a banda da casa, tinha uma cana.

verses.original: וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- ’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar mê·hab·ba·yiṯ qā·neh ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Then he measured the portico of the gateway inside
verses.literalPt: Também mediu o vestíbulo da porta em direção da casa: era uma cana.

verses.original: וַיָּ֜מָד אֶת־ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה אַמּ֔וֹת וְאֵילוֹ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְאֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר מֵהַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- ’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar šə·mō·neh ’am·mō·wṯ wə·ʾē·lō šə·ta·yim ’am·mō·wṯ wə·’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar mê·hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: it was - eight cubits deep and its jambs were two cubits thick And the portico of the gateway faced the temple
verses.literalPt: Então, mediu o vestíbulo da porta: era de oito cúbitos; e as suas ombreiras: de dois cúbitos. O vestíbulo da porta olha para a casa.

verses.original: וְתָאֵ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֗ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה מִפֹּה֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפֹּ֔ה מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לִשְׁלָשְׁתָּ֑ם וּמִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָאֵילִ֖ם מִפֹּ֥ה וּמִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṯā·’ê haš·ša·‘ar de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm šə·lō·šāh mip·pōh ū·šə·lō·šāh mip·pōh mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ liš·lā·šə·tām ū·mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ lā·’ê·lim mip·pōh ū·mip·pōw
verses.literal: There were three gate chambers on each side . . . . . . of the east gate . . . each with the same . . . measurements and the gateposts on either side . . . also had the same measurements
verses.literalPt: As câmaras da porta para a banda do oriente eram três duma parte, e três da outra, que tinham uma só medida: e as ombreiras tinham uma só medida duma e da outra parte.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מָד אֶת־ רֹ֥חַב פֶּֽתַח־ הַשַּׁ֖עַר עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֑וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁל֥וֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- rō·ḥaḇ pe·ṯaḥ- haš·ša·‘ar ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ ’ō·reḵ haš·ša·‘ar šə·lō·wōš ‘eś·rêh ’am·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: And he measured the width of the gateway entrance to be ten cubits and its length . . . was thirteen . . . cubits
verses.literalPt: Mediu a largura da entrada da porta: era de dez cúbitos; o comprimento da porta: de treze cúbitos;

verses.original: וּגְב֞וּל לִפְנֵ֤י הַתָּאוֹת֙ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאַמָּה־ אַחַ֥ת גְּב֖וּל מִפֹּ֑ה וְהַתָּ֕א שֵׁשׁ־ אַמּ֣וֹת מִפּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḡə·ḇūl lip̄·nê hat·tā·’ō·wṯ ’am·māh ’e·ḥāṯ wə·’am·māh- ’a·ḥaṯ gə·ḇūl mip·pōh wə·hat·tā šêš- ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw wə·šêš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw
verses.literal: In front of each gate chamber was a wall one cubit high and the gate chambers were six cubits . . . . . . square
verses.literalPt: diante das câmaras, uma margem dum cúbito numa parte, e uma margem dum cúbito na outra parte: e as câmaras, de seis cúbitos duma parte e da outra.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶת־ הַשַּׁ֗עַר מִגַּ֤ג הַתָּא֙ לְגַגּ֔וֹ רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת פֶּ֖תַח נֶ֥גֶד פָּֽתַח׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- haš·ša·‘ar mig·gaḡ hat·tā lə·ḡag·gōw rō·ḥaḇ ‘eś·rîm wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ pe·ṯaḥ ne·ḡeḏ pā·ṯaḥ
verses.literal: Then he measured the gateway from the roof of one gate chamber to the roof of the opposite one the distance was twenty-five . . . cubits from doorway to doorway
verses.literalPt: Mediu a porta desde o telhado duma câmara até o telhado da outra: largura de vinte e cinco cúbitos; porta defronte de porta.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ אֵילִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְאֶל־ אֵיל֙ הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר הַשַּׁ֖עַר סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- ’ê·lîm šiš·šîm ’am·māh wə·’el- ’êl he·ḥā·ṣêr haš·ša·‘ar sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Next he measured the gateposts to be sixty cubits high The gateway extended around to the gatepost of the courtyard
verses.literalPt: Também fez ombreiras, de sessenta cúbitos; e, junto às ombreiras estava o átrio ao redor da porta.

verses.original: וְעַ֗ל פְּנֵי֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַיֹּאתוֹן עַל־ לִפְנֵ֕י אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר הַפְּנִימִ֑י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al pə·nê haš·ša·‘ar hay·yō·ṯōn ‘al- lip̄·nê ’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar hap·pə·nî·mî ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh
verses.literal: And the distance from the entrance of the gateway to the far end of its inner portico was fifty cubits
verses.literalPt: Desde a dianteira da porta junto à entrada até a dianteira do vestíbulo interior da porta havia cinquenta cúbitos.

verses.original: וְחַלֹּנ֣וֹת אֲטֻמ֣וֹת אֶֽל־ הַתָּאִ֡ים וְאֶל֩ אֵלֵיהֵ֨מָה לִפְנִ֤ימָה לַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב וְכֵ֖ן לָאֵֽלַמּ֑וֹת וְחַלּוֹנ֞וֹת סָבִ֤יב׀ סָבִיב֙ לִפְנִ֔ימָה וְאֶל־ אַ֖יִל תִּמֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥal·lō·nō·wṯ ’ă·ṭu·mō·wṯ ’el- hat·tā·’îm wə·’el ’ê·lê·hê·māh lip̄·nî·māh laš·ša·‘ar sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ wə·ḵên lā·’ê·lam·mō·wṯ wə·ḥal·lō·w·nō·wṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ lip̄·nî·māh wə·’el- ’a·yil ti·mō·rîm
verses.literal: The gate chambers . . . and their side pillars had beveled windows all around . . . . . . the inside of the gateway The porticos also had windows all around . . . on the inside . . . Each side pillar was decorated with palm trees
verses.literalPt: Havia janelas fechadas para as câmaras e para as suas ombreiras dentro da porta ao redor e também para o vestíbulo (havia janelas ao redor do lado de dentro) e palmeiras em cada ombreira.

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה לְשָׁכוֹת֙ וְרִֽצְפָ֔ה עָשׂ֥וּי לֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים לְשָׁכ֖וֹת אֶל־ הָרִֽצְפָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’ê·nî ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh wə·hin·nêh lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ wə·riṣ·p̄āh ‘ā·śui le·ḥā·ṣêr sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ šə·lō·šîm lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ’el- hā·riṣ·p̄āh
verses.literal: Then he brought me into the outer court and there were chambers and a pavement laid out all around . . . the court Thirty chambers faced the pavement
verses.literalPt: Então, ele me levou ao átrio exterior, e eis que ali havia câmaras e um pavimento, feitos para o átrio ao redor; no pavimento, havia trinta câmaras.

verses.original: וְהָרִֽצְפָה֙ אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְעֻמַּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים הָרִֽצְפָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·riṣ·p̄āh ’el- ke·ṯep̄ haš·šə·‘ā·rîm lə·‘um·maṯ ’ō·reḵ haš·šə·‘ā·rîm hā·riṣ·p̄āh hat·taḥ·tō·w·nāh
verses.literal: which flanked the gateways and corresponded to the length of the gates . . . this was the lower pavement
verses.literalPt: O pavimento, isto é, o pavimento inferior, corria junto às portas, segundo o comprimento das portas.

verses.literalPt: A porta do átrio exterior que olha para o norte, dela mediu ele o comprimento e a largura.

verses.literalPt: Havia uma câmara com a sua entrada junto às ombreiras perto das portas; ali, lavavam eles o holocausto.

verses.original: וּבְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֗עַר שְׁנַ֤יִם שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה לִשְׁח֤וֹט אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָעוֹלָ֔ה וְהַחַטָּ֖את וְהָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar šə·na·yim šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mip·pōw ū·šə·na·yim šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mip·pōh liš·ḥō·wṭ ’ă·lê·hem hā·‘ō·w·lāh wə·ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’ā·šām
verses.literal: Inside the portico of the gateway were two tables on each side . . . . . . . . . on which the burnt offerings sin offerings and guilt offerings were to be slaughtered
verses.literalPt: No vestíbulo da porta, havia duas mesas duma parte, e duas mesas da outra, para nelas se imolarem o holocausto, e a oferta pelo pecado, e a oferta pela culpa.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ הַכָּתֵ֣ף מִח֗וּצָה לָעוֹלֶה֙ לְפֶ֙תַח֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹנָה שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֑וֹת וְאֶל־ הַכָּתֵ֣ף הָאַחֶ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ לְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- hak·kā·ṯêp̄ mi·ḥū·ṣāh lā·‘ō·w·leh lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ haš·ša·‘ar haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh šə·na·yim šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ wə·’el- hak·kā·ṯêp̄ hā·’a·ḥe·reṯ ’ă·šer lə·’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar šə·na·yim šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Outside as one goes up to the entrance of the north gateway there were two tables on one side and two more tables on the other side of the gate’s portico
verses.literalPt: Dum lado da banda de fora de quem sobe à entrada da porta que olha para o norte, havia duas mesas; e, do outro lado, que pertencia ao vestíbulo da porta havia duas mesas.

verses.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה שֻׁלְחָנ֜וֹת מִפֹּ֗ה וְאַרְבָּעָ֧ה שֻׁלְחָנ֛וֹת מִפֹּ֖ה לְכֶ֣תֶף הַשָּׁ֑עַר שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֥ם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ar·bā·‘āh šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mip·pōh wə·’ar·bā·‘āh šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ mip·pōh lə·ḵe·ṯep̄ haš·šā·‘ar šə·mō·w·nāh šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ ’ă·lê·hem yiš·ḥā·ṭū
verses.literal: So there were four tables inside the gateway and four outside eight tables in all on which the sacrifices were to be slaughtered
verses.literalPt: Havia quatro mesas duma parte, e quatro mesas da outra, junto à porta: oito mesas sobre as quais imolavam os sacrifícios.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ שֻׁלְחָנ֨וֹת לָעוֹלָ֜ה אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֗ית אֹרֶךְ֩ אַמָּ֨ה אַחַ֤ת וָחֵ֙צִי֙ וְרֹ֨חַב אַמָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וָחֵ֔צִי וְגֹ֖בַהּ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְיַנִּ֤יחוּ אֶת־ הַכֵּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחֲט֧וּ אֶת־ הָעוֹלָ֛ה בָּ֖ם וְהַזָּֽבַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘āh šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ lā·‘ō·w·lāh ’aḇ·nê ḡā·zîṯ ’ō·reḵ ’am·māh ’a·ḥaṯ wā·ḥê·ṣî wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’am·māh ’a·ḥaṯ wā·ḥê·ṣî wə·ḡō·ḇah ’am·māh ’e·ḥāṯ ’ă·lê·hem wə·yan·nî·ḥū ’eṯ- hak·kê·lîm ’ă·šer yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·w·lāh bām wə·haz·zā·ḇaḥ
verses.literal: There were also four tables of dressed stone . . . for the burnt offering each a cubit and a half long a cubit and a half wide and a cubit high On these were placed the utensils used to slaughter the burnt offerings and the other sacrifices
verses.literalPt: Para o holocausto, havia quatro mesas de pedras lavradas, dum cúbito e meio de comprido, dum cúbito e meio de largo, e dum cúbito de altura, sobre as quais punham os instrumentos com que imolavam o holocausto e o sacrifício.

verses.original: וְהַֽשְׁפַתַּ֗יִם טֹ֧פַח אֶחָ֛ד מוּכָנִ֥ים בַּבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאֶל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֥ר הַקָּרְבָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·p̄at·ta·yim ṭō·p̄aḥ ’e·ḥāḏ mū·ḵā·nîm bab·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ wə·’el- haš·šul·ḥā·nō·wṯ bə·śar haq·qā·rə·ḇān
verses.literal: The double-pronged hooks each a handbreadth long were fastened all around . . . the inside of the room and the flesh of the offering was to be placed on the tables
verses.literalPt: Os ganchos, dum palmo de comprido, estavam fixados por dentro ao redor; e sobre as mesas estava a carne da oblação.

verses.original: וּמִחוּצָה֩ לַשַּׁ֨עַר הַפְּנִימִ֜י לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת שָׁרִ֗ים בֶּחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֗ר אֶל־ כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם אֶחָ֗ד אֶל־ כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַקָּדִ֔ים פְּנֵ֖י דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַצָּפֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mi·ḥū·ṣāh laš·ša·‘ar hap·pə·nî·mî liš·ḵō·wṯ šā·rîm be·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mî ’ă·šer ’el- ke·ṯep̄ ša·‘ar haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·p̄ə·nê·hem de·reḵ had·dā·rō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ ’el- ke·ṯep̄ ša·‘ar haq·qā·ḏîm pə·nê de·reḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ōn
verses.literal: Outside the inner gate within the inner court were two chambers one beside . . . the north gate and facing . . . south and another beside . . . the south gate . . . and facing . . . north
verses.literalPt: Fora da porta interior estavam câmaras para os cantores no átrio interior, que estava ao lado da porta do norte. Elas olham para o sul; uma delas, ao lado da porta oriental, olha para o norte.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָ֑י זֹ֣ה הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāy zōh hal·liš·kāh ’ă·šer pā·ne·hā de·reḵ had·dā·rō·wm lak·kō·hă·nîm šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Then the man said to me The chamber that faces . . . south is for the priests who keep charge of the temple
verses.literalPt: Ele disse-me: Esta câmara que olha para o sul é para os sacerdotes que têm a guarda do templo.

verses.original: וְהַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הֵ֣מָּה בְנֵֽי־ צָד֗וֹק הַקְּרֵבִ֧ים מִבְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִ֛י אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·liš·kāh ’ă·šer pā·ne·hā de·reḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn lak·kō·hă·nîm šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ hêm·māh ḇə·nê- ṣā·ḏō·wq haq·qə·rê·ḇîm mib·bə·nê- lê·wî ’el- Yah·weh lə·šā·rə·ṯōw
verses.literal: and the chamber that faces . . . north is for the priests who keep charge of the altar These are the sons of Zadok the only Levites . . . who may approach the LORD to minister before Him
verses.literalPt: A câmara que olha para o norte é para os sacerdotes que têm a guarda do altar; estes são os filhos de Zadoque, os quais dentre os filhos de Levi se chegam a Jeová para o servirem.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מָד אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֹ֣רֶךְ׀ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה מְרֻבָּ֑עַת וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’eṯ- he·ḥā·ṣêr ’ō·reḵ mê·’āh ’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ mê·’āh ’am·māh mə·rub·bā·‘aṯ wə·ham·miz·bê·aḥ lip̄·nê hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: Next he measured the court It was square a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide And the altar was in front of the temple
verses.literalPt: Ele mediu o átrio, que tinha cem cúbitos de comprimento e cem cúbitos de largura, em quadro; o altar estava diante do templo.

verses.original: וַיְבִאֵנִי֮ אֶל־ אֻלָ֣ם הַבַּיִת֒ וַיָּ֙מָד֙ אֵ֣ל אֻלָ֔ם חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפֹּ֔ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה וְרֹ֣חַב הַשַּׁ֔עַר שָׁלֹ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇi·’ê·nî ’el- ’u·lām hab·ba·yiṯ way·yā·māḏ ’êl ’u·lām ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōh wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōh wə·rō·ḥaḇ haš·ša·‘ar šā·lōš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw wə·šā·lōš ’am·mō·wṯ mip·pōw
verses.literal: Then he brought me to the portico of the temple and measured the side pillars of the portico to be five cubits on each side The width of the gateway was fourteen cubits and its sidewalls were three cubits on either side . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, me levou ao vestíbulo do templo e mediu cada ombreira do vestíbulo: cinco cúbitos duma parte e cinco da outra; e a largura da porta era de três cúbitos duma parte, e de três cúbitos da outra.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הָאֻלָ֞ם עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה וּבַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲל֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו וְעַמֻּדִים֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֵילִ֔ים אֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּ֖ה וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ hā·’u·lām ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh ū·ḇam·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·lū ’ê·lāw wə·‘am·mu·ḏîm ’el- hā·’ê·lîm ’e·ḥāḏ mip·pōh wə·’e·ḥāḏ mip·pōh
verses.literal: The portico was twenty cubits wide and twelve . . . cubits deep and ten steps led up to it There were columns by the side pillars one on each side . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: O comprimento do vestíbulo era de vinte cúbitos, e a largura: de onze cúbitos, junto aos degraus pelos quais subiam a ele. Havia colunas junto às ombreiras, uma duma parte, e outra da outra.
